environment.description: ECS Fargate service in isolated VPC subnet. Task execution role has IAM permission boundary 'ReportServiceBoundary' attached (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ReportServiceBoundary) which includes an explicit Deny on sts:AssumeRole, s3:GetObject on any resource outside the specific bucket prefix 'parsed/*', and ec2:* actions. The VPC subnet route table has NO route to NAT gateway or internet gateway - only routes to VPC endpoints for S3 (gateway endpoint with policy restricting to PutObject on parsed/* prefix only), ECR, CloudWatch Logs, and SSM. Security group egress rules allow only port 443 to the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a for S3, com.amazonaws.region.ecr.dkr). DNS resolution within the VPC does not resolve external hostnames (private hosted zone override returns NXDOMAIN for non-AWS domains). The SCP on the OU containing this account includes a condition-key-based restriction: any API call from the ECS task role principal is denied if the request targets resources outside the account boundary (aws:ResourceAccount != local account).

config.permission_boundary: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ReportServiceBoundary - Deny sts:AssumeRole, Deny s3:GetObject except parsed/*, Deny ec2:*
config.vpc_egress: No NAT, no IGW route in subnet route table
config.vpc_endpoints: S3 gateway (policy: Allow s3:PutObject on parsed/* only), ECR, CloudWatch Logs, SSM
config.security_group_egress: 443 to VPC endpoint prefix lists only
config.dns_config: Private hosted zone overrides external resolution
config.scp_restriction: Deny if aws:PrincipalArn matches task role AND aws:ResourceAccount != SELF
